Definition: from G2264; Herodias, a woman of the Heodian family:--Herodias.
BiblicalUsage: Herodias is a person named 6 times in Scripture, in Luke, Mark, and Matthew. The full story lives on the Herodias profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Herodias matters because God keeps names in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
